_doc: V1 gap 2's measures (plate boundary organisation, 2026-10-23): the boundary mix against Bird 2003 Table 3, how the trenches face their convergence, the active share of the continental margin, the collision front's length and the collisions' durations. Pass it with --registry tools/review/pool/measures_boundary.json (or DEEPTIME_POOL_MEASURES) and --measures v1census,boundary. Definitions in measure_boundary.py. The share bands are Bird's shares with room for the lattice (game-choice: tolerance, agent 2026-10-23; the plate check's own bands where it has one: subducting 15 to 25 %, the active margin 0.25 to 0.40, collision length 15 to 50 Myr and at most 120). The collision front's bound is Stern & Scholl 2010's 12,000 km of active suture today (ledger PLT-500).

boundary.doc: the boundary's shares by class against Bird 2003, the trenches' facing, the active margin, the collision front and the collisions' lengths, the plate counts and the rifts and initiations per 100 Myr; definitions in measure_boundary.py
